# zego_uikit_prebuilt_call

**Tag**: call, call-invitation, video-call, audio-call, offline-call, ui

## 简介

PrebuiltCall is a full-featured call kit that provides a realtime call invitation, voice/video chat, device detection, etc. Add a voice/video call to your app in minutes.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.zegocloud.com/
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/ZEGOCLOUD/zego_uikit_prebuilt_call_flutter
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/zego_uikit_prebuilt_call
